rationale: Record a fetch-path change that crosses the render-assets-and-backends family only through tools/scripts/fetch_skia_for_release.py. The fetcher now copies the pinned Skia archive from a tartci host artifact cache (TARTCI_ARTIFACT_CACHE/sha256/<pinned digest>) when one is mounted, re-verifies the same SHA-256 it already enforced, and downloads on a miss, an unreadable share or a mismatch. The pin, the accepted bytes, the unpacked generation and every render path are unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
